title: French Defense: Exchange Variation
line: White trades in the center, the position opens, and Black's shut-in bishop is free.

steps.text: Here White trades pawns in the center.
Take back with the pawn on e6. Now your bishop on c8 is free.

wrong.d8d5: The queen takes, but White's knight comes out and hits her, and White gains time.

also.f8d6: That also works. This lesson brings the knight out first.

steps.text: Bring the bishop out, so you can castle.

also.c7c5: That also works. This lesson goes on with the bishop.

steps.text: Castle. Your king goes to safety, and a rook comes toward the center.
Bring the free bishop out to pin White's knight.
steps.after: The knight is pinned to White's queen, and the bishop that the French often shuts in is active.

summary: When White trades in the center, the position is open, and the bishop that was shut in comes out freely.
